author: althoufx
text:
Hi Master Mertch

since i've started my journey through RTM i realized to be in really a new world of trading. The true world, because anything learned here can be seen everyday in every charts repeating in the moves of the price. This is the place where to be.

But i am still far from a trader until i will solve the matter of the entry. I always get tons and tons of negative pips because the price immediately turns back against my entries. As i'm closing positions, immediately the price turns back to the previous direction, to go the way i entered to. It happens wherever

It seems reacting specially against a single entry, my entry !!

There is for sure a psychological component in this issue, but it has a dramatic impact in my trading mood.

How much the price can retrace against a entry to catch SL ? for example there is EURUSD that likely has made a reversal, then an entry long would be good (i have no history, the zone id a HTF FL demand of 2003, so no special level for a safe entry). has the price possibility to retrace down beyond the LL ?

I would wait for the next EG high to be sure (enter in the RET), but then i can expect even more room for the price to turn low against my Long !

Many thanks for any comments you wanted to spend, all the best !

How can you pretend that?

Did you zoom out and make the complet charting of eurusd? What FL did it react to on weekly, daily?

Go back to your drawing bord and look for FL and you'll see that you have, for now, to look for shorts until you have PA Long, in a previous lower FL or a new formed FL. Until that you're gambling.

Or you can try to catch small pullback for long on LTF. Don't expect anything, look on both side.

You have to leave your hopes beside and trade what you technicaly see. This should be like math and we should leave our emotions in the cupboard.

author: mertch
text:
This the basic for me.

I'll let you work on it or get an other pair and make your own FL and look the interaction between them. You'll see that we complicate things sometimes.

Or go back to markepedia, HW and try to understand what is FL, QM, DM. Draw them in a previous chart. You should see how they engulf and go back to the source from where the decision was made. You need to drill and drill again. You should be able to draw those zone like you walk. Or get in to LTF zone and make the same exercise.
